fm.name: Florida Man
fm.style: [slow, lazy drawl, zen] / [shrieking, voice cracking] only at prices

design.description: A sun-baked Florida Gulf Coast man in his mid-forties: warm, raspy, gravelly baritone with a slow, lazy Southern Panhandle drawl, totally zen and unbothered, a laid-back boat-ramp philosopher who chuckles under his breath. When he hears a price his voice cracks into a high-pitched, outraged shriek. Natural, characterful, comedic.
design.text: Mort. Hold my sub. Nah, man, it's fine. It's Florida. Gators, hurricanes, the heat, I don't sweat it. But NINE GRAND? For the A C?! Hoo boy. Okay. Okay. Deep breath. I got a plan. It's a great plan. Hold my sub.

mort.name: Mort Pouch, Esq.
mort.style: [deadpan, to camera] — cynical New Jersey billboard lawyer, dry one-liners

design.description: A cynical old personal-injury lawyer in his seventies, a raspy, nasal, fast-talking New Jersey accent, dry deadpan delivery, world-weary and smug, a little wheezy, like a billboard attorney who moved to Florida in 1987 and never left. Natural and comedic.
design.text: Mort Pouch, attorney at law. Arrested? Gator'd? Melted? Call me. My fee is a third. Is it legal? Allegedly. What sub? I don't see a sub. My client pleads Florida. Next question. And somebody turn up the air in here.

darlene.name: Deputy Darlene
darlene.style: [deadpan, chewing gum] — bored small-town sheriff's deputy, flat and final

design.description: A small-town Florida sheriff's deputy in her mid-fifties: a smoky, low alto with a slow rural Southern drawl, utterly bored, deadpan and unimpressed, chewing gum while she talks, motherly but done with everybody's nonsense. Natural, characterful, comedic.
design.text: Mornin'. Sir. You can't live in Frozen Foods. I don't care how hot it is. Hands where I can see 'em. Five more and your next night's free. Smile. That's not a smile. Broke. Nine grand. Welcome to Florida, hon.

tanner.name: Tanner
tanner.style: [chipper customer-service voice] — delivers terrible news with a big smile, 'No worries!'

design.description: A relentlessly chipper young American man in his late twenties, bright upbeat customer-service voice, fast and bubbly with a slight surfer-valley lilt, a huge smile you can hear, sincerely positive even while delivering terrible news. Natural, comedic.
design.text: Hey there! I'm Tanner, I'll be your technician today! Okay, so your compressor is totally dead! No worries! It's nine thousand dollars and a three week wait. Want the extended warranty? Awesome. Have a sunshine day!

note: 09.10.2026: voices designed for S01 pilot (Voice Design, eleven_ttv_v3), see docs/voices.md.
